findings.issue: Nested version regex repetitions overlap on hyphen characters, so the 256-character length guard does not bound matching work.
findings.proof: Public dependency_value on '1-' + 'a-' * 28 + '!' (59 characters) exceeded the isolated two-second operational budget. Shorter observations and exact harness are retained; this is not a timing-based unit-test assertion.
findings.required_correction: Replace ambiguous backtracking in both literal and constraint classification with bounded deterministic scanning or a demonstrably linear finite grammar. Preserve supported exact versions, prereleases, constraints and redaction. Add deterministic work/regression assertions for adversarial short values and maximum accepted lengths.

findings.issue: The prospective check uses character count, then allocates the complete UTF-8 bytes before checking their byte cost.
findings.proof: With max_text_bytes=5, three astral characters caused a 12-byte encode allocation before dependency-limit. The later failure correctly poisons result access, but the configured allocation budget was already exceeded.
findings.required_correction: Determine bounded UTF-8 byte cost without first allocating the oversized encoding, including remaining aggregate capacity and surrogate rejection. Preserve valid exact-capacity ASCII/BMP/astral inputs; add a counted allocation-boundary assertion rather than timing checks.

findings.issue: Wildcard version components are reported as literal exact declarations.
findings.proof: 1.*, 1.x, 1.2.* and 1.X return literal, while standalone * returns constraint. The shared-contract owner confirmed literal is intended to distinguish an exact syntactic version from wildcard/range constraints.
findings.required_correction: Classify wildcard components as constraints and retain actual exact-version/prerelease controls. Neither category may assert installed or evaluated resolution.

findings.location: dependency_inputs.py public carriers/helpers; test_dependency_inputs.py parameterized helpers
findings.issue: Presence-only docstring checks do not satisfy the mandatory contract documentation requirements.
findings.proof: For example, safe_identifier:114 and dependency_value:178 omit typed parameter meanings; DependencyBudget.reserve:339 omits the independent units/return contract; DependencyBudget and DependencyResult class summaries omit lifecycle/counter semantics. Parameterized test/helper docstrings similarly omit the injected parameter contracts.
findings.required_correction: Complete concise purpose, typed parameters, return/raises/side-effect contracts and non-obvious class lifecycle/invariants in the owned shared subset. Preserve intent comments and the 500-line limit; obtain coordinator authorization before any cohesive helper split.
